findings.title: traceID no longer included in "Plugin Request Completed" log line
findings.body: Before this change, logRequest explicitly looked up the trace ID with tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) and appended it as a "traceID" log parameter. This PR removes the tracing import and that logic, switching to m.logger.FromContext(ctx) which only picks up the attributes injected by the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware: endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, and uname. Nothing in the new middleware chain adds the trace ID to the contextual attributes (instrumentContext in contextual_logger_middleware.go only adds the five fields listed above, and grafana's infra/log contextual logger does not add trace IDs automatically). As a result, the "Plugin Request Completed" log entries lose their traceID field, breaking log-to-trace correlation for anyone relying on this well-known egress log line (eventName=grafana-data-egress). The trace ID should be re-added, either by appending it in instrumentContext (e.g. via tracing.TraceIDFromContext) or explicitly in logRequest.
